sources.quote_original: En reumatología, aunque no existen cifras oficiales del número exacto de especialistas activos, se estima que Chile cuenta con alrededor de 300 reumatólogos, entre adultos y pediátricos. Según el registro de prestadores de salud, 286 médicos están acreditados como reumatólogos/as, ya sea por universidades que imparten la subespecialidad o por la Comisión Nacional de Certificación de Especialidades Médicas (CONACEM).

sources.quote_original: Actualmente, tres universidades imparten programas de formación en reumatología en pacientes adultos. Estos tienen una duración de cuatro semestres y corresponden a subespecialidades derivadas de la medicina interna. A pesar de que la oferta anual de cupos es reducida (entre 6 y 12) y se reconoce la falta de estos especialistas, en los últimos años no se han llenado todas las vacantes.

open_questions.question: Does the Universidad de Chile Facultad de Medicina accept a Ukrainian police-record certificate (apostilled and translated) in place of the Chilean 'Certificado de antecedentes vigente' that every batch demands?
open_questions.why_it_matters: It is a mandatory antecedente in all four current batches. A Chilean certificado de antecedentes is issued by the Registro Civil to people with a Chilean identity number. If no foreign substitute is accepted, her application is inadmissible at stage 1 regardless of merit, and the whole 'apply from Ukraine' route collapses.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Email rrhhacademicos.med@uchile.cl and concursos.med@uchile.cl, quoting the bullet 'Certificado de antecedentes vigente a la fecha de postulación', and ask what a non-resident applicant should submit.

open_questions.question: At which exact point in the concurso does 'acreditarse el cumplimiento de las normas sobre extranjería' bite: at application, at award, or only at signature of the contrata?
open_questions.why_it_matters: This is the ordering problem. If immigration compliance is tested at APPLICATION, she cannot apply from Ukraine at all. If at signature, she can win the post first and use the award to support a visa application, which reverses the whole strategy.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Ask the Subdirección de Relaciones Humanas of the Facultad de Medicina in writing, and cross-check with lane L09 on Ley 21.325 subcategorías.

open_questions.question: Would a Comisión de Concursos accept a Ukrainian rheumatology specialty certificate as satisfying an admissibility line reading 'Especialidad Médica en Medicina Interna' or 'Especialidad Médica en Reumatología', without CONACEM certification?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Every medical academic post found states a specialty as a hard admissibility requirement. Academic bases never mention CONACEM (clinical convocatorias always do). If the Comisión reads the specialty line as satisfied by an apostilled foreign certificate, the academic route is genuinely open; if it requires Chilean certification, the academic route inherits the clinical route's full burden.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Ask the Facultad de Medicina directly, and ask CONACEM whether a Ukrainian certificate is admissible input (lane L05).

open_questions.question: Is the language of the oposición teaching presentation ever anything other than Spanish, and does any Chilean medical faculty run an English-track programme where it would not be?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The oposición is worth 1000 points with a 600 pass mark and is scored partly on clarity of exposition. If Spanish is unavoidable, Spanish tuition is the critical path and everything else is secondary.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Ask the Departamento that owns a target concurso; cross-check with lane L06 question 7 on English-track programmes.

open_questions.question: What are the actual pay figures for a Universidad de Chile academic contrata at 11, 22 and 44 hours?
open_questions.why_it_matters: None of the four batch pages or the MD2624 bases states a remuneration. Without it she cannot judge whether an 11-hour Carrera Docente post is economically viable, nor compare it with the $3.596.483 a 44-hour public clinical specialist post pays.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Chilean state universities publish staff pay under the transparency law; query the Universidad de Chile transparency portal, or ask rrhhacademicos.med@uchile.cl.

open_questions.question: Do the UNAB posts advertised through the Colegio Médico board require a revalidated Chilean title, Chilean residency, or EUNACOM?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Private universities are outside the Estatuto Administrativo entirely and are usually the easier employer for a foreigner, which would make UNAB a better first target than Universidad de Chile. The requisitos are locked inside .docx attachments that were not opened.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Download and read the four .docx files linked from the Colegio Médico post, or contact UNAB Facultad de Medicina directly.

open_questions.question: Is there any published MINSAL or Superintendencia figure for the rheumatology-specific gap, or a rheumatology breakdown of the specialist waiting list?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Every 'shortage' argument for rheumatology currently rests on one professional-society article that itself says the data does not exist. Without a number, the demand case is qualitative.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Query the Repositorio Nacional de Listas de Espera (minsal.cl/rnle/) and the Superintendencia's Registro Nacional de Prestadores Individuales by specialty; the article states rheumatology is usually folded into 'otras especialidades'.

unknowns_declared: Whether a Ukrainian police-record certificate substitutes for the Chilean 'certificado de antecedentes' demanded by all four Universidad de Chile batches: NOT FOUND.
The pay attached to any Universidad de Chile academic contrata post at 11, 22 or 44 hours: NOT STATED anywhere on the concurso pages or in the MD2624 bases that were read.
The requisitos for the four UNAB academic posts: they exist only inside .docx attachments that were not opened, so their eligibility rules for a non-resident foreigner are unverified.

Whether Universidad de Chile academic bases treat a foreign specialty certificate as satisfying an 'Especialidad Médica' admissibility line: the bases are silent and no dictamen or precedent was found.
Whether SOCHIRE operates a bolsa de trabajo: sochire.cl returned HTTP 403 to direct fetch on 2026-09-03 and no jobs section could be confirmed. Treat 'SOCHIRE has a job board' as unverified.
The full text of the trabajando.cl rheumatologist listing in Quilpué: it appeared in search results but the URL returned HTTP 404 when fetched on 2026-09-03, so it may already be filled or withdrawn.

Any rheumatology-specific waiting-list or brecha figure from MINSAL: NOT FOUND. The only rheumatology numbers in this lane come from one professional-society article, which itself states no official count of active rheumatologists exists.

Whether the empleospublicos convocatoria's rendering of Ley 18.834 art. 12 letter a) as 'Ser ciudadano o extranjero poseedor de un permiso de residencia' matches the statute: NOT verified against LeyChile in this lane. Lane L06 owns that.

Current academic vacancies at PUC, Universidad de Concepción, Universidad Austral, Universidad de La Frontera, Universidad de Antofagasta and the other medical faculties: NOT SWEPT. Only Universidad de Chile, USACH, Universidad de Valparaíso and whatever surfaced on the Colegio Médico board were checked. The claim 'no rheumatology academic post is open in Chile today' is therefore bounded by that sweep, not national.
Whether the Hospital Clínico Universidad de Chile rheumatology post advertised on 1 June 2026 was awarded, declared desierto, or re-advertised: NOT FOUND.

Whether Universidad de Chile has published any change to its concurso rules following the 17 August 2026 entry into force of Decreto 174/2024: NOT FOUND. The bases read were signed 24 July 2026, i.e. before that date, so their treatment of foreign titles is PRE-change evidence being applied in a POST-change window.
Every academic concurso page consulted at Universidad de Chile is UNDATED as a web page; the dates used are those inside the linked Resoluciones Exentas and the stated application windows.
